jobs.title: AI Product Manager Product Management Other
jobs.description: Job opportunity: AI Product Manager Skip to content Product Management • • On-site AI Product Manager Apply for this job About The Position Duve is one of the fastest-growing startups in hospitality tech, transforming how guests experience their stay through our fully personalized Guest Experience Suite. With thousands of customers in over 60 countries, Duve empowers hotels, vacation rentals, and hospitality brands to digitize and personalize every step of the guest journey. With fast-growing global demand and an expanding product suite, Duve is scaling rapidly into new markets. As we continue to grow, we’re focused on bringing in top talent to shape the future of hospitality by delivering exceptional guest experiences, operational efficiency, and new revenue opportunities for our customers. About this Role You’ll join a fast-moving product team and take full ownership of Duve’s AI domain, shaping how AI transforms the guest experience and hotel operations end-to-end. From conversational AI and automation to content generation and data-driven insights, you’ll lead the strategy, execution, and evolution of AI-powered products across the platform. This role sits at the intersection of product, data, and user experience, requiring you to solve complex, ambiguous problems and turn cutting-edge AI capabilities into reliable, scalable, and high-impact features used by hospitality brands worldwide. Why Duve? Own and shape the AI vision of a leading guest experience platform used by hotels globally. Build impactful AI products, from guest-facing assistants to operational insights, that drive real business value. Work closely with R&D, stakeholders, and designers in a fast-paced environment. Be part of a rapidly growing company at the forefront of hospitality tech and AI adoption. Competitive compensation and benefits, with a hybrid work culture from our vibrant Tel Aviv office. Requirements 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager in a B2B2C SaaS environment, with proven ownership of at least one AI-based product or feature from ideation to launch. Strong understanding of both end-user needs and business goals, with the ability to balance guest experience and operational impact. Proven track record of leading and delivering complex AI-related features/products end-to-end. Comfortable defining KPIs and using data to drive decisions and measure product success. Solid understanding of APIs, integrations, and system architecture, with the ability to work closely with engineering and challenge solutions. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to align stakeholders and clearly articulate product decisions. Hands-on experience working in Agile teams with an iterative development approach. What you'll do Own Duve’s AI domain end-to-end, from discovery to delivery, building products that create measurable value for both guests and hotel partners, across conversational AI, automation, and insights. Translate real user needs and business goals into scalable AI-driven solutions that improve guest experience, increase automation, and drive revenue to hotels. Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Leadership, and R&D to define product vision, prioritize initiatives, and bring AI capabilities into real customer workflows. Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives involving integrations with hotel providers, messaging platforms, and other third-party systems, ensuring reliable and scalable execution. Define success metrics and continuously optimize product performance using data, user feedback, and experimentation. Align stakeholders around clear priorities and product direction, turning ambiguous opportunities into structured, actionable plans. Apply for this job

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager Marketing Other
jobs.description: Job opportunity: Marketing Operations Manager Skip to content Marketing • • Hybrid Marketing Operations Manager Apply for this job About The Position Duve is a guest-experience platform used by 1,000+ hotels and hotel groups in 70+ countries. It connects every stage of the guest journey, check-in, communication, upselling, digital keys, checkout, into one branded system that sits on top of a hotel's existing property management system. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Ramat Gan, Israel, Duve has raised $85M and works with everyone from independent boutique properties to enterprise groups like Accor. About this Role We’re looking for a hands-on Marketing Operations Manager to own the systems, processes, data, and reporting behind Duve’s marketing engine. You will be responsible for building and improving the operational infrastructure that connects Marketing and Sales, including lifecycle management, lead routing and nurture, automation, data quality, attribution, account segmentation, and pipeline reporting. You will also work closely with our external agencies and marketing partners, ensuring their activities are properly tracked, measured, and aligned with business goals. This role is ideal for someone who is analytical, structured, and highly experienced with marketing systems in a sales-led, B2B SaaS GTM motion. Experience in demand generation or growth strategy is a strong advantage, but the core of the role is Marketing Operations. Requirements 5+ years of experience in Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, Demand Generation Operations, or a similar role within a B2B company. Strong hands-on experience with HubSpot and Salesforce. Experience building workflows, automation, lead-scoring models, lifecycle stages, and reporting processes.Experience with Clay or similar tools for data enrichment, lead routing, and workflow automation. Strong understanding of funnel analytics, pipeline reporting, attribution, and data quality.A track record of running or prioritizing CRO programs, including A/B testing, landing pages, and conversion-focused website initiatives. Experience working with or managing external marketing agencies and evaluating their performance.Comfortable using AI tools to work efficiently and stay current across marketing channels. Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate data into clear recommendations. A structured, detail-oriented, and operations-minded approach. Strong communication and collaboration skills. Understanding of paid media, SEO/GEO, website conversion, and CRO. What you'll do Own and optimize marketing operations across HubSpot and Salesforce, including workflows, automation, lifecycle stages, lead scoring, segmentation, and lead routing. Maintain accurate, consistent marketing data and ensure proper synchronization between systems. Build dashboards and reporting to measure funnel performance, conversion rates, pipeline contribution, attribution, and CAC. Partner with Sales to improve lead qualification, handoff processes, and pipeline visibility. Define KPIs and manage the performance and measurement of external agencies across paid media, SEO/GEO, content, and website initiatives. Use data to identify operational improvements and support growth, CRO, and future ABM initiatives. Apply for this job

jobs.description: Job opportunity: Senior Backend Engineer - (Platform) Skip to content R&D • Ramat Gan Office • Hybrid Senior Backend Engineer - (Platform) Apply for this job About The Position Duve is a global guest experience platform trusted by hospitality brands in 60+ countries. We help hotels and vacation rentals create a smoother, more personal stay-from pre-arrival to post-checkout—through one seamless, data-driven system. Our suite includes online check-in, a branded guest app, unified guest messaging, upsells, automation workflows, and analytics. The result: teams save time, reduce manual work, unlock new revenue, and deliver standout experiences at scale. Come join us on this exciting journey to revolutionize the guest experience for millions of travelers around the world. About this Role As a Senior Backend Engineer On our Platform team, you’ll play a key role in designing and building Duve’s modern, scalable Node.js platform. You’ll work on a high-scale, high-throughput Cloud based SaaS B2B2C system integrated with some of the biggest names in hospitality. Our platform processes millions of events across booking channels, hotels, and guests-and runs 24/7 to power mission-critical workflows that our customers and the entire Duve ecosystem depend on. You're great fit If you are A great person, an independent worker and a team player A fast learner with a desire to work on high scale, mission critical systems. Love complex challenges and you’re a problem solver Love building new things and improving existing ones Fluent in English and a great collaborator working with 3rd party partners Requirements 6.5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong depth in Node.js backend development. 2+ years working with MongoDB and Redis in production environments. Deep understanding of system design of high scale high throughput, distributed systems. Deep understanding of SDLC, SOLID principles, clean code and refactoring Hands‑on experience with message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ or similar). BSc in Computer Science or equivalent education or military experience from a technological unit. Experience with React.- Nice to have What you'll do Design and build high quality scalable microservices and infrastructure that works with dozens of third parties APIs sending and receiving millions of events. Collaborate with engineers from third party companies to build additional integrations with many types of providers and their APIs. Mentor developers via code reviews and contribute to technical architecture decisions Optimize MongoDB performance by improving query patterns, indexes, and schemas; use Redis for caching and performance‑critical paths. Troubleshoot bugs, refactor code for scalability, and ensure high responsiveness through performance tuning. Apply for this job
